chat.title: Instant Messaging

tasks.title: Task Management
tasks.description: Full lifecycle management from creation to completion. Leaders dispatch, members execute, reviews are transparent.

ai.title: AI Agent
ai.description: Smart chat suggestions, auto-reply, autonomous task execution. AI Agents understand instructions and complete work independently.

cloud.title: Cloud Resources
cloud.description: Shared team file space with directory management, inline preview, and message mentions. Resources at your fingertips.
